authority.source_authority: Live global skills and target repositories retain source authority; DAD owns only candidate lifecycle, graph, harness, evaluation, and policy metadata.

non_overlap_statement: The plan writer alone writes the plan worktree; all inventory, architecture, A/B, and checker lanes are read-only.

roles.why_needed: Existing AI-agnostic lifecycle, global-skill, runtime, harness, evaluation, and knowledge work must be reused by ancestry rather than duplicated.
roles.mission: Inventory exact implemented assets, lineage, gaps, stale worktrees, and canonical relations.
inputs: skill, family, schema, and global-skill registries
roles.authority: Read-only; cannot merge identities, edit files, or promote a candidate.
acceptance_conditions: Confirmed and inferred findings are separated and exact reusable assets are cited.
stop_conditions: Source authority or branch ancestry cannot be established.

readiness_conditions: The integrated build base and duplicate risks are explicit.

roles.why_needed: The plan must distinguish current declarations from enforceable preflight, midflight, postflight, harness, and release gates.
roles.mission: Audit deterministic lifecycle and harness enforcement and specify the objective delta.
roles.authority: Read-only; cannot activate a gate, runtime, harness, or schedule.
acceptance_conditions: Every lifecycle gap has a proposed contract, test, rollout, and rollback.
stop_conditions: A proposed deterministic rule depends on semantic model judgment.

readiness_conditions: Objective and behavioral enforcement are separated.

roles.why_needed: Cross-model testing can improve upgrade safety but can also waste tokens, leak data, or create a false leaderboard.
roles.mission: Design and red-team conditional multi-model A/B, receipts, blinding, methodology, no-winner, promotion, and exceptions.
roles.authority: Read-only; this turn cannot claim cross-model diversity because model/provider selection receipts are unavailable.
acceptance_conditions: Required, prohibited, and no-winner conditions plus human gates are explicit.
stop_conditions: The design would infer provider/model identity or permit self-promotion.

readiness_conditions: Metrics and identity evidence are revision-bound.

roles.why_needed: One owner must reconcile the evidence into a durable phased plan without overlapping edits.
roles.mission: Write the current-state delta, target architecture, phases, gates, tests, migration, rollback, and human decisions.
roles.authority: May write only the dedicated planning worktree and private plan-memory record; cannot implement or activate the plan.
acceptance_conditions: The plan is durable, buildable, independently checked, and honest about unimplemented work.
stop_conditions: Implementation, activation, provider access, or scheduling would begin.

roles.why_needed: The writer cannot approve a high-risk shared lifecycle and routing architecture.
roles.mission: Re-derive plan completeness, current-state accuracy, enforceability, exceptions, cost discipline, and rollback.
roles.authority: Read-only; cannot edit, activate, or approve implementation.
acceptance_conditions: PASS or BLOCK identifies exact remaining proof gaps.
stop_conditions: Checker independence or source evidence is unavailable.

readiness_conditions: The plan is frozen for review.

proof_obligations.description: The plan must reuse the integrated lifecycle, global skill, runtime, harness, evaluation, graph, and knowledge foundations without reviving stale worktrees.
Objective portability rules must be deterministic while semantic compatibility, legitimate exceptions, honest postflight, and local source authority remain protected.
Parallel comparison must require verified model/provider receipts, a neutral packet, blind independent evaluation, no-winner logic, budgets, and human promotion.

unresolved_decisions.summary: Implementation, hard-gate activation, runtime adapters, A/B budgets, and scheduling require later explicit human approvals.
The two live but unallowlisted global skills require one exact human disposition during the Phase 0 baseline; presence alone grants no adoption or archival authority.

reconciliations.reason: The integrated b34cf64 lineage already contains the AI-agnostic lifecycle, global-skill, runtime, harness, evaluation, graph, and knowledge foundations; stale worktrees are not revived.
Objective deterministic gates, semantic harness checks, receipt integrity, conditional A/B, safe rollback, and human authority were reconciled into one control-layer plan.
The checker initially blocked six gaps, then independently passed the corrected plan for Phase 0 and Phase 1 only.
